subject: Re: MAP checkpoint & commercial terms — pilot -> committed ramp
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmecorp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-02T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual action plan + pilot pricing proposal
Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf

Hi Naomi / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo — the team at Acme is excited to move forward with a 30-day pilot focused on support-chat re-ranking and a production readiness evaluation. We've put together a preliminary MAP attached (MAP_v1.pdf) that proposes milestones, acceptance criteria, and a close timeline. High level: 

- Week 0: PO kickoff + integration checklist (baseline throughput + test prompts)
- Day 30 checkpoint: MAP checkpoint review (quality gate + latency SLO validation)
- Ramp phase (month 2–3): staged production roll to 3 inference nodes for 10k qps baseline
- Commercial close: decision to commit and invoice schedule by end of month 3

For pricing, the procurement team has asked us to get a written proposal that ties discounts to committed spend and successful MAP checkpoints. Can you share a pricing iteration that maps discounts to commit levels and a ramp schedule? Ideally we want milestone-based invoicing and clarity on what constitutes 'successful' at day 30.

Also looping in Procurement for any initial redlines: procure@acmecorp.com

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Li
Head of Product Partnerships, Acme Corp
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-03T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + pilot pricing proposal
Attachments: pricing_proposal_v1.xlsx

Hi Samantha — really appreciate the clear MAP. We've sketched a pricing iteration (attached) that links discounts to committed annualized spend post-pilot and lays out a ramp schedule tied to the MAP checkpoints. Summary of the proposal:

- Pilot (30 days): no commit, fixed pilot fee of $7,500 (covers infra + support)
- If day-30 checkpoint passes (quality & latency within agreed gates), Acme may opt into a 12-month commit.
- Commit tiers and discounts (post-pilot):
  - $250k/year commit -> 25% off list (recommended for initial production)
  - $500k/year commit -> 33% off list + priority capacity
  - $1M+/year commit -> 40% off list + dedicated pool option
- Ramp expectations: start with 1 node (prod test), expand to 3 nodes over 6 weeks after commit; autoscaling to handle spikes.

Action items I propose:
1) Confirm acceptance criteria for the day-30 checkpoint (we recommend sample prompt set + latency target < 120ms P95 for core flows).
2) Procurement to confirm invoicing cadence (milestone-based vs monthly).
3) Schedule checkpoint review call for the week of Apr 13 — I'll block a 30-minute slot.

Marcus and Markus — flagging the commit tiers above; let me know if we need alternate strings or ramp protections (SLA credits, fallback variants).

Cheers,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-05T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan + pilot pricing proposal

Naomi — quick notes on the commercial side:

- Discount triggers look reasonable. Recommend adding a 6-week ramp protection window where discounts are pro-rated if Acme hits 75% of the committed QPS within 6 weeks of go-live. This avoids over-indexing on an early spike.
- For the dedicated pool option at $1M+, make sure we include a clear fallback to multi-tenant with SLA credits if dedicated capacity is delayed.
- Ask Legal to prepare a SOW + MAP addendum that enumerates acceptance tests and milestone-based invoicing.

Markus, can you confirm we can support the 120ms P95 target with their expected prompt profile? If not, we'll propose a slightly relaxed latency gate and compensate with a tighter quality threshold.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Revenue Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Acme Corp Procurement <procure@acmecorp.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-09T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Acme redlines & invoicing questions
Attachments: acme_redlines_20260409.docx

Hi Naomi / Samantha,

Attached are our initial commercial redlines. Two items we'd like to clarify before we proceed:

1) Invoicing cadence: we prefer milestone-based invoicing tied to the MAP checkpoints (30-day acceptance, 90-day production ramp) rather than upfront annual invoicing. Please mark which milestones will be billable.
2) Acceptance criteria: we need explicit pass/fail gates for the day-30 checkpoint — sample prompts + labels and an objective quality score threshold (e.g., 0.82 average precision on our eval).

We have also requested a clause that ties the agreed discount to a minimum committed ARR; if the commit is not reached within 90 days post-pilot, discounts will be adjusted pro-rata.

Please review the redlines and provide a counter that maps payments to milestones.

Best,
Procurement Team
Acme Corp
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@acmecorp.com>, Acme Corp Procurement <procure@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint & commercial terms — pilot -> committed ramp
Attachments: MAP_final.pdf

Hi Samantha / Procurement team — thanks for the redlines and the clarity on invoicing. We've incorporated your milestone billing preference and updated the MAP and pricing accordingly. Key items we've agreed internally and are proposing for MAP_final.pdf attached: 

- Pilot (30 days): fixed fee $7,500, payable at kickoff.
- Day-30 checkpoint: acceptance gates = (1) latency P95 < 120ms on agreed prompt set, (2) avg precision >= 0.82 on labeled eval set. Successful checkpoint unlocks the option to commit.
- Post-pilot commit options (choose within 14 days of checkpoint):
  - $250k/year -> 25% discount, 6-week prorated ramp protection (discounts adjusted if only 75% of committed QPS reached in 6 weeks)
  - $500k/year -> 33% discount + priority capacity
  - $1M+/year -> 40% discount + dedicated pool (with fallback & SLA credit clause)
- Invoicing: milestone-based (pilot fee at kickoff, 50% of first commit at commit signature, remainder invoiced monthly) — details in MAP_final.pdf.
- If commit is not met within 90 days of pilot, discount will be pro-rated per redline.

Next steps: 
1) Please confirm acceptance criteria and the chosen commit tier by Apr 16 so we can prepare SOW + DocuSign.
2) I'll send the DocuSign link for the MAP + SOW once you confirm tier.
3) Checkpoint review call: Apr 14, 09:30–10:00 PT (I've sent a calendar invite).
